title: Uncategorized's QuickBooks Products and Services can be changed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks, so the QuickBooks Products and Services field shows.
  • Note Uncategorized's QuickBooks Products and Services item (item P), and choose another item of the client's QuickBooks to use in the test (item Q).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click Uncategorized's row.
  3. Pick item Q in QuickBooks Products and Services.
  4. Reload the page.
  5. Pick item P in QuickBooks Products and Services.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Uncategorized is the first row.

Step 2:

  • Uncategorized's page opens; Pricing Matrix and Tax Exempt show grayed.
  • QuickBooks Products and Services shows item P and can be clicked (it is not grayed).

Step 3:

  • QuickBooks Products and Services shows item Q, with no Save button needed.

Step 4:

  • After the reload, QuickBooks Products and Services still shows item Q.
  • Pricing Matrix still reads General Matrix, grayed.

Step 5:

  • QuickBooks Products and Services shows item P again, as it was before the test.
